entity_count_guidance: 12-18 entities: the Analyst, 2-3 fully realised Hosts, the rival Guests as entities even when offstage, 3-4 locations, 2-3 objects (polaroids, a cassette, the ritual), 1-2 groups, 1-2 concepts (the Memory Wipe, the Daywalker Ritual)
note: Three plots: the external game the Analyst is solving, the antagonist plot of the town waking up, and his internal collapse from detachment into moral reckoning. The Psychologist's interference must causally link the first to the second.
